Penthouse

Emperor Suite 901 Penthouse

Welcome to your private residence high above Medellín. The Emperor 901 Suite is a spectacular four-bedroom duplex where unforgettable moments are created, whether you're traveling with friends or family. Wake up to breathtaking city views, spend your afternoons relaxing in your private jacuzzi, and gather in a spacious living room designed for connection and comfort. With two king beds, two queen beds, and thoughtfully designed spaces on two levels, every guest enjoys privacy and luxury, plus a premium sound system with a soundbar, perfect for elevating your stay with an immersive audio experience.

Amenities

Everything you need

In addition, our guests can enjoy a variety of extra services, including buffet breakfast, 24-hour reception, 24-hour security, room service with a full menu available at all times, a cozy coffee shop, exclusive access to our heated pool and rooftop bar, where you can enjoy a stunning 360° panoramic view of the captivating city of Medellín.
